c10: Floating don't know if that is Mobile
c19:
We are working to open a community sauna social enterprise in Kelowna, BC by 2027, with sliding-scale pricing built into the model from the beginning. We will use a portion of the funds generated by our floating sauna to help make this project possible and keep access affordable.

We will also work with local community and health organizations to explore social prescribing and other ways of creating funded or lower-cost access for people who may not otherwise be able to afford sauna.

As we develop the space, we will continue learning from and working with the communities around us so that cultural safety, accessibility and community needs are actually part of how the sauna is built and operated not something added on afterward.
